# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD decision files the content audit found missing.

dod_form_grossdeutschland = {
	is_shown = {
		OR = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german country_has_primary_culture = cu:rheinish }
		NOT = { exists = c:GER }
		NOT = { c:GER ?= this }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		any_scope_state = { count >= 14 state_region = { OR = { is_homeland = cu:north_german is_homeland = cu:south_german is_homeland = cu:rheinish } } }
	}
	when_taken = {
		change_tag = GER
		add_primary_culture = cu:north_german
		add_primary_culture = cu:south_german
		add_primary_culture = cu:rheinish
		add_modifier = { name = dod_ger_kingdom months = 120 }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 80 }
}
